items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I don't remember knowing any of them that well at different churches.

ctx.x: The pastor . . . I don’t know what to call him now, reverend, whatever he was. He’d be in the pulpit. We’d do the psalm, do the different psalms, and then there would be a hymn. And then there . . . my father would sing the hymn very lustily. I can do that. I remember some of those. But then it would come the sermon. It was always so boring, and I would be squirming around. I would . . . My mother didn’t go too much. My father would . . . and I would say, “Can we leave before the sermon?” Once in a great while he…
Yeah, did your mother either, or you, play religious music around the house at any stage or at the church or anything?
